Foreman '''Gragov''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] employee of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] who worked in the [[Czerka Sentient Resources Department]] as the [[Facility Maintenance Manager]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
